concepts.title: Multiplication of a Fraction by a Whole Number
concepts.definition: To multiply a whole number with a fraction, multiply the whole number with the numerator, keeping the denominator same. For mixed fractions, first convert to improper fraction.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply whole number by numerator, keep denominator. Convert mixed to improper first.
question_patterns: multiply a fraction by a whole number
find the product of fraction and whole number
multiply and reduce to lowest form
multiply and express as mixed fraction
what is a fraction times a number
how much distance will it cover
how much total given rate and quantity
find total given per unit and number of units

solution_steps.action: convert mixed to improper if needed
solution_steps.explain: If mixed fraction, convert to improper: a (b/c) = (a*c + b) / c
Reduce to lowest form. Convert to mixed fraction if improper.

concepts.title: Fraction as Operator 'of'
concepts.definition: The word 'of' represents multiplication. (a/b) of n = (a/b) x n.
question_patterns: what is a fraction of a number

solution_steps.action: identify the fraction and the whole

solution_steps.explain: result = (a/b) x n = (a x n) / b

concepts.title: Multiplication of a Fraction by a Fraction
concepts.definition: To multiply two fractions, multiply numerators together and denominators together. (a/b) x (c/d) = (a x c) / (b x d).
concepts.key_idea: Product of numerators over product of denominators.
question_patterns: find the product of two fractions
multiply and reduce to lowest form
fill in the boxes fraction multiplication

concepts.title: Value of Product of Two Fractions
concepts.definition: Product of two proper fractions is less than each fraction. Product of two improper fractions is greater than each. Product of proper and improper is between them.
concepts.formula: proper x proper < each; improper x improper > each
concepts.key_idea: Proper x proper = smaller. Improper x improper = larger.
question_patterns: is product less than or greater than
value of product of two proper fractions
value of product of two improper fractions
which is greater product or fraction

solution_steps.explain: Check if proper (numerator < denominator) or improper

concepts.title: Reciprocal of a Fraction
concepts.definition: The reciprocal of a fraction is obtained by inverting it (swapping numerator and denominator). Two numbers are reciprocals if their product is 1.
concepts.key_idea: Flip the fraction to get its reciprocal. Product of reciprocals is 1.
question_patterns: find the reciprocal of a fraction
classify reciprocals as proper improper or whole

solution_steps.explain: Swap numerator and denominator: a/b becomes b/a
If b > a, reciprocal is improper. If b < a, reciprocal is proper. If b = 1, reciprocal is whole number a.
Check (a/b) x (b/a) = 1 to confirm the reciprocal is correct

concepts.title: Division of Whole Number by a Fraction
concepts.definition: To divide a whole number by a fraction, multiply the whole number by the reciprocal of the fraction. n / (a/b) = n x (b/a).
concepts.key_idea: Dividing by a fraction = multiplying by its reciprocal.
question_patterns: find n divided by a fraction

solution_steps.action: convert mixed to improper if needed
solution_steps.explain: If divisor is mixed, convert to improper fraction
n / (a/b) = n x (b/a) = (n x b) / a

concepts.title: Division of a Fraction by a Whole Number
concepts.definition: To divide a fraction by a whole number, multiply the fraction by the reciprocal of the whole number. (a/b) / n = (a/b) x (1/n) = a / (b x n).
concepts.key_idea: Dividing a fraction by n = multiplying by 1/n.
question_patterns: find a fraction divided by a number

concepts.title: Division of a Fraction by Another Fraction
concepts.definition: To divide one fraction by another, multiply the first fraction by the reciprocal of the second. (a/b) / (c/d) = (a/b) x (d/c) = (a x d) / (b x c).
concepts.key_idea: Dividing by a fraction = multiplying by its reciprocal.
question_patterns: find a fraction divided by a fraction

concepts.title: Multiplication of Decimal Numbers
concepts.definition: To multiply two decimals, multiply them as whole numbers, then count total decimal places in both numbers and place the decimal point that many places from the right.
concepts.formula: 0.a x 0.cd = (a x cd) with (1+2)=3 decimal places
concepts.key_idea: Multiply as whole numbers, count decimal places, place decimal point.
question_patterns: find the product of two decimal numbers

solution_steps.explain: Count digits to right of decimal in both numbers, add them
In the product, count from right and place decimal point at the summed position

concepts.title: Multiplication of Decimal by 10, 100, 1000
concepts.definition: When multiplying a decimal by 10, 100, or 1000, shift the decimal point to the right by as many places as there are zeros.
concepts.formula: d x 10 = shift right 1; d x 100 = shift right 2; d x 1000 = shift right 3
concepts.key_idea: Shift decimal point right by number of zeros.

solution_steps.explain: Move decimal point right by that many places
Add zeros if not enough digits

concepts.title: Division of Decimal by 10, 100, 1000
concepts.definition: When dividing a decimal by 10, 100, or 1000, shift the decimal point to the left by as many places as there are zeros.
concepts.formula: d / 10 = shift left 1; d / 100 = shift left 2; d / 1000 = shift left 3
concepts.key_idea: Shift decimal point left by number of zeros.

solution_steps.explain: Move decimal point left by that many places

concepts.title: Division of Decimal by Whole Number
concepts.definition: To divide a decimal by a whole number, divide as whole numbers then place the decimal point in the quotient at the same position as in the dividend.
concepts.formula: d.n / w = divide ignoring decimal, place decimal at same position
concepts.key_idea: Divide as whole numbers, keep decimal position.

solution_steps.explain: Treat the decimal as a whole number (e.g., 6.4 becomes 64)
Divide the whole number by the divisor
Place decimal in quotient so it has same decimal places as dividend

concepts.title: Division of Decimal by Another Decimal
concepts.definition: To divide a decimal by another decimal, shift the decimal point in both numbers to make the divisor a whole number, then divide.
concepts.formula: a.b / c.d = (a.b x 10^n) / (c.d x 10^n) where n makes divisor whole
concepts.key_idea: Shift both decimals same places to make divisor whole, then divide.

solution_steps.explain: Count digits to right of decimal in divisor
Multiply both by 10^n to make divisor whole
Now divide decimal (shifted) by whole number (shifted)
